title: Agentic AI Enabling Autonomous, Self-Organizing, and Evolving UAV Networks
summary: As low-altitude applications expand across emergency response, intelligent transportation, and autonomous operations, they demand communication networks that can deliver flexible, resilient, and rapidly deployable connectivity. Heterogeneous UAV networks are a promising solution, as they can dynamically provide sensing, access, relay, and backhaul functions.
